integrity.limits: No claim of independent validation or unreviewed general polygon inversion.
integrity.numerical_check: standalone reproducible rational, quadrature, and independent sampling checks
integrity.proof_type: finite exact integration and elementary covariance calculation

scientific_limitations: A fixed nondegenerate Euclidean triangle and independent arclength-uniform endpoint pairs are assumed.
Only proper intersections inside the triangle count; same-edge chords are excluded.
Similarity is identifiable; scale requires an independently measured perimeter.
Exact population moments are assumed; statistical estimation error is not analyzed.
Literature checks do not certify historical uniqueness; the full Gates (1982) paper was inaccessible.
title: Three-chord crossing-count tomography of Euclidean triangles
